### Don't Do It for Them - iBelieve Truth - May 17, 2024
Author: Meg Bucher
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/dont-do-it-for-them.html
Passage: Isaiah 66:13
Points:
- Comforting our children does not mean rescuing them from every challenge or micromanaging their decisions.
- God demonstrates true care by granting His children freedom to learn from real-world mistakes while offering guidance when they seek Him.
- Offloading age-appropriate responsibilities builds maturity, confidence, and resilience in young people.
- Parents reflect divine comfort best by encouraging, listening, and trusting God with their children's growth.

### What Does Isaiah 66:13 Mean by ‘As a Mother Comforts Her Child, So Will I Comfort You?’
Author: Candice Lucey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/special-coverage/mothers-day/what-does-isaiah-6613-mean-by-as-a-mother-comforts-her-child-so-will-i-comfort-you.html
Passage: Isaiah 66:13
Points:
- Scripture employs the tender imagery of maternal care to illustrate the depth and warmth of God's comfort.
- All loving, nurturing qualities found in mothers ultimately originate in and are perfected by the Creator.
- Earthly mothers can find their identity and daily sacrifices validated by God's recognition.
- Those who experienced absent or imperfect mothers can find complete healing in God's constant, unconditional love.
- Believers receive endurance and divine solace from the Lord so they can extend comfort to others.
